zh:
昆士兰大学（The University of Queensland，简称UQ）成立于1909年，位于澳大利亚昆士兰州布里斯班市，是澳大利亚八校联盟核心成员，也是澳大利亚顶尖的公立研究型大学。学校下设12个学院，覆盖医学、法律、商学、工程、艺术、教育等领域，在校生超60000人，其中研究生约22000名。
昆士兰大学在2026QS世界大学排名中位列全球第43位，同时位列昆士兰州毕业生就业能力第1位。学校培养了2位诺贝尔奖得主、1位澳大利亚总理，在生物科学、环境科学、矿业工程、医学等领域拥有卓越的学术实力，是澳大利亚获得国家级教学奖项最多的大学，注重教学质量与科研成果转化。2026QS世界大学排名中，昆士兰大学位列世界第43位。
en: The University of Queensland (UQ) is a public research university in Australia. Founded in 1909, it is located in Brisbane, Queensland, and a core member of the Group of Eight. The University comprises 12 faculties, covering medicine, law, business, engineering, arts, and education, with over 60,000 enrolled students, including 22,000 graduate students. Ranked 43rd globally in the 2026 QS World University Rankings, it is 1st in Queensland for graduate employability. It has produced 2 Nobel Prize winners and 1 Australian prime minister, and is Australia's most awarded university for teaching excellence. Ranked No.43 in the world in the 2026 QS World University Rankings.
